messages.subject: [Fedora-r-devel-list] R-patched in Fedora (feedback from R-devel)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
	while reading the Rdevel list I found this quote from Peter Dalgaard:
https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-devel/2007-November/047366.html

"(Fedora incorporated patches in their RPM updates for a while, which I
was beginning to believe was a good idea, all things considered, but
they haven't done it (yet?) for 2.6.0.)"

	Funny. :-)
-- 
José Abílio

messages.subject: [Fedora-r-devel-list] [Idea]: pre 2.6.1 in updates-testing?
messages.body_plain:
There are release candidates for R 2.6.1 that is expected to be release next 
Monday (26).

Those daily release candidates are placed here 
http://cran.r-project.org/src/base-prerelease/

I think that we could push those release candidates to updates-testing to 
detect earlier problems. In any case we have to deal in the first push of the 
new version with the dependency of rpy.

Regards,

-- 
José Abílio
